content:
Rowan: Quick shout 00% energy — we crossed 3M requests this week. Taco cart and confetti at 5? :taco: :confetti_ball:
Priya: WOAH that escalated. tacos yes. I call dibs on carnitas. :raised_hands:
Tomas: also shoutout to the retry logic that saved a bunch of p99s. ops team ftw. :mechanical_arm:
ops-bot: autoscaler adjusted pools from 8 -> 12 at 2419000999 (reason: sustained CPU)
Lila: I made a tiny banner: "3M requests, still humming" 022px font, courier. will print.
Rowan: can we do outside patio? feels like sunshine celebration. react with :sunny: for patio, :desktop_computer: for lounge
Priya: patio! need chairs though. I can snag folding chairs from storage.
Tomas: I can bring a Bluetooth speaker and a kazoo. yes, kazoo.
Rowan: kazoo is non-negotiable. :kazoo:
catering-bot: taco cart vendor options: El Cantina (vegan options), Salsa Bros (gluten-free tortillas), Street Tacos R Us (kid-friendly). Reply with vendor name to pick.
Priya: El Cantina for vegan options pls.
Lila: quick idea: mini sticker pack for folks who stayed late this sprint. 8 designs.
Rowan: sticker idea: "I helped ship GA" + tiny GPU icon.
Tomas: can we have a tiny photo booth? tripod + instant camera?
Priya: yes, and someone to take team photo for #all-hands slide. I can make the slide after lunch.
Rowan: milestone shout: +120% week-over-week API usage, first time multi-tenant caches hit 95% hit rate. small victories.
Lila: incoming: confetti cannon is probably too extra but 1 small popper? :eyes:
Tomas: small popper approved. Rowan, can you coordinate with facilities for cleanup?
Rowan: on it. also RSVP in thread if youre coming so catering knows numbers.
Priya: RSVP yes
Tomas: RSVP yes
Lila: RSVP yes
ops-bot: reminder: rooftop occupancy limit 30 at 2419001200 — coordinate with facilities for permits if above threshold
Rowan: planning for 18 people, should be fine. See you all 17:00 on the patio. :tada:
